1 scam reported in Spencer for week ending July 11, 2026
S. R. Lopez
The Better Business Bureau listed one scam in Spencer for the week ending July 11, 2026.
No scams were reported in the city the previous week.
One report included a dollar amount, with reported losses totaling $207.
The largest reported loss for the week was $207 in a moving scam. The report stated: "This company said they could ship my car from GA to IN. For $350 She asked for a TWO hundred dollar deposit. Turns out it was 207. Then she gives me the date the car will be picked up. The next day she calls and says theres trouble finding a driver so that will be more money. I told her i found a different driver and already had the car in route to me. I messaged her about a refund for the $207 and she said it has been initiated and will be 7-8 business days to be deposited. Now i have tried messaging her again and no response from anyone."
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their own experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to show large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
